hook: A lock-free index that still does range scans

beats.say: Researchers from UT Austin and ETH Zurich built Arctic, a lock-free adaptive radix tree. They say no index before offered high performance, lock freedom and range scans together.
A freezing-based coordination protocol keeps it non-blocking, and a new memory reclamation scheme uses operation keys to approximate reachable pointers.
Swapped in for the default skiplists, it raised write-heavy throughput by up to 40 percent in RocksDB and 12 percent in Turso.
